Public saunas in San Francisco, CA

San Francisco's public sauna options range from Archimedes Banya, a large Russian-style bathhouse on the Bay in Hunters Point, to Japanese-inspired communal baths in Japantown and the Tenderloin. Newer spots include a waterfront barrel sauna with a cold plunge at Crane Cove Park and a sauna garden on Post Street. Most venues take reservations, and several rotate between co-ed and single-gender days, so check the schedule before you go.

5 venues, each checked against the venue's own website on 2026-11-02. Fields we could not confirm are marked Unknown. Prices and hours change, so confirm before you go.

Archimedes Banya

Hunters Point · 748 Innes Ave, San Francisco, CA 94124
Russian banyaElectricSteam roomBathhouse
Drop-in price
$72 Basic Banya Pass (3-hour entry); $60 weekday Happy Hour pass (entry 12-4pm, 3 hours); $95 All Day Pass
Session length
3 hours (Basic and Happy Hour passes) or all day
Cold plunge
Cold water plunge pool
Schedule / who
18+ with valid government ID. Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 12pm-11pm; Sat-Sun 10am-11pm; last check-in 9pm. Women's Night 5-10pm on the first Tuesday of the month and Men's Night 5-10pm on the third Tuesday.
Notes
Two Russian saunas with large tiled stoves (170-210°F), a Finnish dry sauna, a Turkish hammam steam room, warm pools, jacuzzis, a bar mezzanine and a roof deck with Bay views. Aromatherapy sessions daily at 3pm, 7pm and 9pm. Heat source for the saunas is not stated, so treat the type as approximate.

BathhouseSteam room

Schedule / who
Reservations required. Women: Sun, Wed, Fri (bathing suit optional). Men: Thu, Sat (bathing suit optional). All gender: Mon, Tue (bathing suits required). Hours Mon 2pm-8pm, Tue-Sun 10am-9:30pm. Photo ID required; ages 12-18 only with a parent or guardian.
Notes
Japanese-inspired communal bathhouse in the Japan Center, open since 1968. Hot pool (104°F), cedar-lined dry sauna (150°F), steam room (120°F) and seated Japanese-style showers. Quiet house: no talking and no phones in the baths.

Tenderloin · 466 Eddy St, San Francisco, CA 94109
BathhouseSteam room

Cold plunge

Schedule / who
18+. Mon 4pm-10pm men (bathing suit optional); Wed 4pm-10pm women (bathing suit optional); Thu 2pm-10pm co-ed; Fri-Sun 10am-10pm co-ed (bathing suits required on co-ed days). Reservations recommended; walk-ins welcome based on availability. Max 4 guests per reservation.
Notes
Small Japanese sento-style bathhouse with a 104°F communal tub, redwood sauna and steam room. Robe, towel, sandals, locker and tea included. Bath + dinner option Thursday-Sunday. No refunds on cancellations within 24 hours. Garage across the street at 469 Eddy St.

Dogpatch Paddle Waterfront Sauna

Dogpatch (Crane Cove Park) · 701 Illinois St, Unit A, San Francisco, CA 94107
Outdoor

Cold plunge (about 49°F, ranges 36-55°F)
Schedule / who
Public sessions Tue-Sun 9am-5pm, closed Mondays. Shared sessions up to 4 people; private sessions also available. Ages 16+. Walk-ins usually available on quiet weekdays; reserve ahead on weekends.
Notes
Barrel sauna kept around 190°F, steps from the Bay at Crane Cove Park, run by a kayak and SUP rental shop. Showers, lockers and a changing room included. Bring swimwear and a towel; towels are required in the sauna and rent for $2.
